headline: Indianapolis take the first conference points off Drury
dek: Drury's draw at home to Indianapolis on Saturday was the first conference match they have failed to win, and it left their season at six wins, one draw and one defeat, with twenty-one goals scored and eight conceded. They still lead the table; Lincoln, who play at Truman today, are the only side unbeaten by anyone.
displaced_by: Drury drew at home to Indianapolis on 19 September, so the perfect conference record no longer holds

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southwest Baptist's twenty-eight goals exceed what the five lowest-scoring programmes have managed between them; the shape is no longer one bar and a slope, since Maryville's afternoon against them pulled the second bar close.

wire.line: Lincoln are the last side in the conference without a defeat, and they got there by beating Southwest Baptist.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their date carry no published result, and both are Drury's: at home to Evangel and away at Wash U.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lincoln are the only programme in the conference yet to lose: three wins and two draws, seven goals scored and three conceded, with Wednesday's win at Upper Iowa their first away from home since conference play opened.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ten different players have scored for Drury this season, and none of them appears among the conference's scoring leaders.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Southwest Baptist have won four, drawn one and lost two, Saturday's win at home to Lewis coming after defeats at Lincoln and Maryville; they have scored twenty-eight and conceded fifteen, and at least eight different players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Asgrimur Vidisson has made thirty-three saves for Maryville and conceded eight, a save percentage of .805.

last_match.line: Indianapolis have not lost since their opening conference match at Rockhurst; Drury had not conceded more than once in a conference match before it.

next_match.line: Lincoln have yet to concede away from home in conference play; Truman's only conference defeat came at home, to Drury.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
